title: pm-dispatch: SKILL.md:94 and filing-gate.md:31 still name `claude[bot]` as the write identity — AGENTS.md says every write leaves as `objectstack-fleet[bot]`
body:
Filing-gate category: ③ direct dispatch from the session operator (`os-litant`), instruction quoted verbatim below. It also meets ①: the defect has named locations.
Reader: an `os-dev` subagent, dispatched right after filing from session https://claude.ai/code/session_01X7HwfPLpQtCixDMrRGkSbe. The diff touches `.claude/**` (governed, Tier H), so the PR waits on an approval from `os-zhuang` or `hotlong`.
Dedup (open + closed, MCP `search_issues`): the query "pm-dispatch skill says writes go as claude[bot] but AGENTS.md says objectstack-fleet[bot]" returned 71 hits and none of them is this defect; the query "objectstack-fleet write identity" returned 4 hits, all closed (#19641, #19663, #19701, #19739). Control: "board snapshot archive" returned 5 hits including the known #17434, so the channel is live.

## Instruction (verbatim)

> 另外注意 pm-dispatch 技能文档里有一处过时:SKILL.md:94 和 references/filing-gate.md:31 还写着"写侧恒走 claude[bot]" 这个是错的，立卡修改
>
> 你可以直接派发修改

## What is wrong

`AGENTS.md:416` on `origin/main` (1f89ba0) is the authority:

> **Every GitHub write leaves through `scripts/pm/`, as `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, behind the shared write gate.**

Two lines of the pm-dispatch skill still prescribe the superseded identity:

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:94`: 写侧恒走 `claude[bot]` ⛔ 不走用户令牌;节奏 ≥3 秒/笔、每账号每小时 ≤40 笔,429 即停写。
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md:31`: 立卡、开 PR 与评论恒走 App 安装身份(`claude[bot]`),⛔ 不走席位用户令牌。

`references/rest-channel.md:11` already names the `fleet-write` relay (#19739), so the skill now contradicts itself as well as AGENTS.md. A seat that reads SKILL.md alone is told to write as `claude[bot]`, which is the REST-proxy installation identity, and not through the `scripts/pm/` write doors.

## Fix

1. `SKILL.md:94`: state that the write identity is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the `scripts/pm/` write doors (`issue-create`, `label-write`, `post-stamped`, `close-cards`, and `with-fleet.sh` for everything else), with AGENTS.md as the authority. Keep the pacing half of the line unchanged, and keep the line count unchanged because of the line ratchet.
2. `references/filing-gate.md:31`: make the same identity statement for filing cards, opening PRs and commenting.
3. `references/filing-gate.md:9` is a verbatim maintainer quote from 2026-09-21 that names `claude(bot)`. Rulings are quoted verbatim and are not rewritten. At most, add a one-line note under the quote saying the identity has since moved to `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (AGENTS.md).
4. Re-read `references/filing-gate.md:32-33` and `references/platform-readings.md:130-136` against the new identity. Those lines record measurements of the container's REST-proxy token classes; they are not a write rule. Change a line only if it reads as an instruction to write as `claude[bot]`, and name any such line in the PR.

Out of scope: the `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` H64 fixtures that name `claude[bot]`. They are measured history, not a rule.

## Acceptance

- `git grep -n 'claude\[bot\]' .claude/skills/pm-dispatch` returns no line that prescribes `claude[bot]` as the write identity.
- The skill-face gates stay green: `check-skill-line-ratchet`, `check-governed-prose`, `check-skill-id-lint`.
